_note: THE MEDIC FAMILY, 5: FIELD TRIAGE. Plan: home-office office/projects/delves/medic-family.md.
THE PLAYER'S PART: you bring the med packs and spend them. Each treatment is offered only while you carry one, so three people means three packs, and the warden's order (worst first) is the triage.
Register: the warm common job. You are the one who turns up.

REWORKED 2026-11-10 on OT-9A (Eliza's letter 2026-11-10-eliza-jessica-wounded-and-captives-are-people-now.md, his 'B, it matches vanilla'): the three message boxes became three wounded people in three talks, in a fixed order because talks do not group. The details kept: the cut arm, the burnt hands that say almost nothing, the knock to the head. Voices borrowed until his ear casts them. Pay: med.

FRANCES 2026-11-10 (reviews/2026-11-10-delve-MB87a.md): ship, findings 2-5 taken, 6-7 kept. Forced pick answered YES: each give takes the med pack (OT-34 as built), so the triage spends three and every prompt stands; the card now says three.

CARD 2026-11-10 (his 11-04 ruling, a posting by whoever set the job: no payer label, no payment line; his 11-10 'we still have all those X Contract things'). Was: "Settlement Contract. Treat the wounded settlers at the <Place> on <Planet>. Bring three med packs. Payment on contract completion."

prose.name: Rescue: Field Triage at the <Place> on <Planet>
prose.briefing: Raiders hit the <Place> and left three of its people wounded. The settlement needs someone with med packs.
prose.card: Raiders hit the <Place> and left three of our people wounded. We have nobody who knows what they're doing. Bring three med packs.

beats.objective: Treat the bleeding settler at the <Place>

person.name: Tamsin Rowe
hellos: Over here. I'm the one bleeding.

_bio.from: one of the settlement's own (her lines)
_bio.why_there: cut when the raiders came through at first light (her lines)
_bio.wants: the others seen to; she has been holding her own arm shut since (her lines)

greeting: It's my arm. I've been holding it shut since they left, and my hand's gone numb from doing it.

exchanges.prompt: Let go of it. I've got a med pack.
reply: That stings worse than the cut did. Go on, see to the others. I'll keep.
They came in shooting, took what they could carry, and left us where we fell.

beats.journal: I closed a deep cut on a settler's arm. Next, the one with burnt hands.

beats.objective: Treat the settler with burnt hands

_bio.from: the settlement's grower (his lines: the seed stock)
_bio.why_there: went into a burning store after the seed stock (his lines)
_bio.wants: the seed stock saved; he says almost nothing about himself (his lines)

exchanges.prompt: Hold them out. This will cool them.

reply: They set the store going. I went in.

exchanges.prompt: Did you save any of it?

beats.journal: I dressed a settler's burnt hands. Next, the one who took a knock to the head.

beats._replace: REContainerLocRef is the box itself: his MB87a play, 2026-11-10, "Rory was sat in a chest tho". The box goes at the accept.
beats.objective: Treat the settler who took a knock to the head

_bio.from: one of the settlement's own (his lines)
_bio.why_there: knocked down in the raid and never quite got up (his lines)
_bio.wants: to know what day it is, and to be told he did fine (his lines)

greeting: Someone hit me with something. Or I hit something. What day is it? Don't tell me, I'll get it.

exchanges.prompt: Sit still and look at me. Med pack.
reply: Oh, that's better, the ground's stopped moving. It's Tuesday. Is it Tuesday? I'm going with Tuesday.

exchanges.prompt: How many fingers am I holding up?
reply: Four. Five? You keep moving them about.

beats.journal: Raiders left three people wounded at the <Place>. I treated all three, worst first.

broadcast: They hit us at first light. Three of ours are down. Start with the one who's bleeding, then the hands. The lad who took the knock can wait, he's talking.
_speech: Shaken, holding it together. A stand-in voice; his ear decides.
